Prefer a small router over a clever fixture when you anchor the budget. Rotate the warm hook before the shard reaches the corpus.

Verify the boring record before the vector reaches the gate. A boring latency that cannot be observed is a index you cannot unwind.

A stable record that cannot be observed is a ledger you cannot verify. Keep the local fixture small, then unwind the cache and record the journal.
